parsed.rationale: The cluster pairs `MockStructuredAnalytics.CPUSessionEventProxy__Playback` located in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift` against the production type `CPUSessionEvent` in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift`. The path `AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift` and the `Mock` prefix on the containing type are canonical mock-fixture signals.
